description: Write a job’s People table custom cells: action=batch writes 1-500 cells at expectedVersion (people_table.cells.batch), atomic by default (all or nothing) or mode=independent (each edit commits on its own; retrying with the same idempotencyKey finishes only the edits that had not committed), with one result per edit; dryRun=true checks every edit and writes nothing. A request body over 4 MiB of UTF-8 (limits.writeBodyMaxBytes) is LIMIT_EXCEEDED: split a large batch. Hosted /mcp stops waiting after 180 s, sooner than REST (300 s): for a large batch use mode=independent with an idempotencyKey, and if the call times out retry the same key to finish it. action=set writes or clears (value null) one cell (people_table.cells.set). Address rows by jobPersonId; a row this key cannot reach is a 404. A PERSON value is a jobPersonId on the same job. Only custom columns are editable (custom:<fieldId>); built-in and system columns answer COLUMN_NOT_EDITABLE. Writes go through the web’s own column and cell rules, at expectedVersion (a stale version is VERSION_MISMATCH), and every audit event records an agent actor and the request’s batchId. Writes spend the key’s write budget (60 requests a minute and 10,000 edits an hour across jobs and surfaces; a dryRun counts as a read). Requires people_table:write, except columns action=list (people_table:read).

dryRun.description: batch: check every edit, write nothing.

edits.description: batch: 1-500 edits, each cell at most once.

expectedVersion.description: Exactly the version read: null only for a never_set cell.
Exactly the version read: null only for a never_set cell.

idempotencyKey.description: Required for every write except a dryRun. Same key + same input replays the original outcome; same key + changed input is a 409.

value.description: set: the value; null clears the cell.

name: opentrain_people_table_cells
